name: bounty-guard
description: Zero-dependency pre-flight GitHub bounty security scanner and on-chain Proof-of-Escrow MCP verifier for AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Pre-flight GitHub bounty security and escrow verifier
interface.longDescription: BountyGuard audits open GitHub bounty issues and PRs before an autonomous coding agent invests compute or signs transactions. Classifies bounties into SAFE_WITH_ESCROW, SAFE_NO_ESCROW, or QUARANTINE and verifies on-chain UTXO and Base Mainnet wDOOM escrow backing.
defaultPrompt: Audit this GitHub bounty issue URL with BountyGuard and verify if escrow is locked on-chain.
List all open verified SAFE_WITH_ESCROW bounties from the Doomsday Escrow Registry.
